ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY ACT 1953

ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY (EXEMPTION) (NO. 6) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 12(1)(b) of the

Entertainments Duty Act 1953 [Act 103], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Entertainments Duty (Exemption) (No. 6)

Order 2025.

Exemption

2. The Minister exempts the admission tickets for the shows specified in column (2)

of the Schedule which were held at the venues specified in column (3) on the dates

specified in column (4) from entertainments duty.
